title: Payouts Desk Calendar: Earnings Week, Payout Day and Hold Thresholds
content:
The payout calendar and the hold thresholds of **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** are the same at every Wayfare Pro status: Wayfare Pro Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite.

| Term | Value at every status |
|---|---|
| Earnings week | Monday 04:00 to the next Monday 03:59:59, market local time |
| Day the scheduled weekly payout of the previous earnings week is sent | Tuesday |
| Smallest scheduled payout sent | 0.01 USD; a lower or negative balance carries forward |
| Available balance at or below which payouts are held for negative balance | -150.00 USD (a negative balance of 150.00) |
| Longest a fraud review payout hold may last before it must be released or the agreement deactivated | 30 calendar days |
| Floor for Wayfare Rentals charges paid from earnings | The available balance is never taken below 0.00; the rest stays on the rental to be paid by card |

## Points of reading

- **Which week a trip belongs to.** Earnings posted on a Monday at 03:30 market local time belong to the earnings week that started the Monday before; earnings posted at 04:00 that Monday open the new week.
- **Payout floor.** A balance of 0.01 or more at the week's end is sent on the Tuesday; a balance of 0.00 or a negative balance is not sent and carries forward.
- **Negative balance threshold, both sides.** A hypothetical available balance of -150.00 is at the threshold and places payouts on hold for negative balance; a balance of -149.99 is above it and does not.
- **Fraud review limit.** A fraud review payout hold lasts no more than 30 calendar days.
